items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: went down on the performance night to see Max. Because hell he was the man.

ctx.x: Well you’ve just about done it all.

Well I’ve been lucky. Just blessed, blessed. Then many times I get a break. The drummers would come in. Shelly Manne, Max came in, by then I had left, I was with Fatha Hines and I went down on the jam session, or went down on the performance night to see Max. Because hell he was the man. And a fella named George Morrow was playing bass with him, well George Morrow, we had played together with the Jerome Richardson quartet. See Jerome Richardson’s quartet, see they started cutting back at the Black Hawk. That was…
